hypotheses.justification: After applying ae_iff to each hsection x, Measure.measure_inter_eq_zero_of_restrict shows that the section of s \ G has ν-measure zero without any measurability assumption on s. Use hbad.exists_measurable_subset_ae_eq to obtain a measurable subset t agreeing almost everywhere with s \ G. Its sections are null by monotonicity, so Measure.measure_prod_null proves t null; measure_congr finishes. These steps also cover empty sets and zero measures.

Repeat the referenced proof, replacing the use of Measure.measure_prod_null by Measure.measure_prod_null_of_ae_null, which requires no SFinite instance. The same section argument proves the required almost-everywhere nullity. Moreover, Measure.prod is defined to be zero when ν is not s-finite, so that case holds automatically. This hypothesis and hs can also be deleted simultaneously.
